source: Warmaster Armies v2.26, Magic Items Overview (p.88). Full descriptions are in the main rulebook, p.77.

items.name: The Banner of Steadfastness
items.summary: One shooting hit after saves is ignored.

items.name: The Banner of Fortune
items.summary: Once per game, re-roll all the Attack dice in one Shooting or Combat roll.

items.name: Crown of Command
items.summary: General only. The first Command roll each turn may be taken against an unmodified Command of 10. If that roll fails, the Crown is lost.

items.name: Helm of Dominion
items.summary: General only. The General has +1 Command (maximum 10) for one Command phase.

items.name: Orb of Majesty
items.summary: General only. Re-roll one failed Command roll against a Command value of 8, with all usual adjustments.

items.name: Sceptre of Sovereignty
items.summary: General only. Ignore one Blunder rolled by the General or any other character. That order counts as successful.

items.name: Ring of Magic
items.summary: Wizard only. Cast one spell on a roll of 2+.

items.name: Staff of Spellbinding
items.summary: Wizard or Runesmith. If an enemy Wizard fails to cast a spell, spellbind them on a 4+. A spellbound Wizard has -1 to cast. One use.

items.name: Scroll of Dispelling
items.summary: Wizard or Runesmith. Dispel one enemy spell on a roll of 2+.

items.name: Wand of Power
items.summary: Wizard only. Add +1 to one attempt to cast a spell.

items.name: Rod of Repetition
items.summary: Wizard only. If a spell is cast successfully, once per game immediately try to cast another spell.

items.name: Sword of Destruction
items.summary: One enemy unit in combat with the unit carrying the sword must re-roll one successful Armour roll each combat round.

items.name: Sword of Fate
items.summary: +1 Attack to the unit or character in the first Combat round.

items.name: Sword of Cleaving
items.summary: Re-roll one unsuccessful Attack dice per combat round.

items.name: Sword of Might
items.summary: +1 Attack to the unit or character in the Combat phase.
